ctx.x: Yes, so Mario had one of the best teachers in the country. He was a top ten clarinet player, Hugo Cien, and his godfather, Arturo Andrade, he was a musician in the - for the army - army band, a good musician, so in order he could kill time in Pabolote, he opened a school of music, free; so Mario used to sing by ear all the lessons, when he was seven, so he says: 'Oh yeah, you could sing by ear the lesson? - ah ------
You mean like Do - Re - Mi
